name: Dance Off
hook: Hit the arrows on the beat. Win the crowd's vote.
how: Arrows slide in on the beat: hit the matching arrow and your dancer busts a move. Long streaks unlock bigger moves, from steps to spins to backflips. When the song ends, everyone votes for the best dancer (not themselves).
controls: Arrow keys or WASD; on phones, tap the four arrow buttons
uses: One player's browser counts in each song, runs the vote and counts it; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot dancers hit (and miss) along with you, and vote too, until enough people join.
Every dancer's moves, streak and score show on every screen as they dance.
ideas: Give every dancer a hat they can pick before the song
Add hold arrows you have to keep pressed
Make the stage a beach at sunset
